title: City Council Regular Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Hughes to approve the resolution authorizing the issuance and sale of not more than $7,500,000 aggregate principal amount of the city’s industrial development revenue bonds, series 2020, to finance the costs of a medical office building and related improvements (collectively, the project) for Southwest Utah Community Health Center, Inc.; providing for the publication of a notice of bonds to be issued and a notice of public hearing; providing for the running of a contest period; and related matters.
result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
